name: app-user-journey-map-table-with-emoji-emotion-row
title: User Journey Map Table with Emotion Emoji
whatItIs: A pale grey page titled User Journey Map with a persona card, a scenario card and a goals card, above an eight-column table of stages (Discover to Support) with rows for Activities, Pain Points in red, Touch points and an Emotional row of emoji faces with two-word feelings, the Grow column highlighted in lilac.
whatItMeans: Emoji make emotion readable at a glance, and pale colour-coded rows keep a dense table calm.
techniques: Row labels coloured by type (red for pain)
Emoji row showing emotion per stage
Persona, scenario and goals cards across the top

vocabulary.definition: A phase in a user's experience such as Discover or Support.
A frustration a user experiences at a stage.
A place where the user interacts with the product.
